metadata.title: PyGCMS Pipeline: a configurable and candidate-preserving workflow for nominal-mass pyrolysis GC-MS chromatograms
metadata.description: PyGCMS Pipeline v1.3.1 is an archived browser-based workflow for nominal-mass, MS1, full-scan GC-MS and pyrolysis GC-MS chromatograms. It performs configurable chromatographic deconvolution, submits search-eligible reconstructed spectra to a separately licensed local NIST MS Search installation, and preserves the complete returned top-N hit list with original ranks and scores. Revision 1.3.1 adds a working default synthetic mzML example; a configurable minimum spectral-ion threshold for automatic NIST submission while retaining all components; a top-two unique-species match-gap flag; CAS-based duplicate grouping in the view without altering raw hits; an ambiguity/QC export; an idempotent manual-selection implementation; clearer separation of five application-specific NOM marker groups from a neutral nine-class structural-product summary; expanded NIST and retention-index documentation; browser regression tests; and deconvolution-profile sensitivity summaries. The core deconvolution and candidate-preservation stages can also accept conventional nominal-mass, MS1, full-scan GC-MS mzML after data-specific parameter optimization, although the real-data validation presented with this release is centered on Py-GC/MS. No vendor-native reader, NIST executable, NIST library, licensed spectrum, licence key, or credential is included. Version-specific Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21912995. This reviewer-response archive keeps software version 1.3.1 and backports ClassificationModelVersion 2.0.0 from the tested v1.4.1 classification branch, including exact toluene locking, origin-rule audit fields, and long-format candidate export.
